payload.title: Deployable legal coefficient candidate
payload.statement: The E003 legal datum-plus-trend formulation will retain a material advantage after feature-family ablation, full-training fitting, test-distribution audit, and offline Kaggle inference parity.
payload.evidence_for: E003 scores 10.9280 OOF, wins all five maps, and scores 11.2541 on contiguous spatial blocks with complete controls.
payload.evidence_against: Full-training predictions may shift from averaged OOF models, hidden test distribution may differ, and local CV can invert on the leaderboard.
payload.next_test: E004: frozen feature-family ablations, full-training artifact, train-versus-test drift report, exact submission reconstruction, and Kaggle MCP parity notebook.
